title: THE SIREN MEANS REAL DANGER
why: His orders of 2026-10-13: the siren goes off too often, just taking damage should not throw it, and the alarm for crawlers should be quieter. The lock-on siren used to ring for any machine within 760 that was in the chase state, and a machine goes to chase without seeing him: a shot or a hit heard nearby, a pack call, the last place it knew. So it rang for machines round a corner and every time he took damage. Now a machine counts only while it sees him right now (with a quarter second of grace for a one frame blink), inside 500 (a sentry on alert sees about 460, so this only cuts the long lightning flash sightings), after holding that for 0.6 seconds so a glance round a corner is no lock-on, and once it has stopped it cannot start the siren again for 5 seconds, the same five seconds the SEEN stinger already waits. A crawler counts at half, so a siren with only crawlers on him is half as loud, and the shout alarm a crawler makes when it spots him is half level too. Taking damage alone never starts the siren. Sound only: nothing about how machines see, chase or hit changes.
now: The lock-on siren now only sounds when a machine really sees you, and crawlers are half as loud.
